اشتملتما (form VIII)
# اِشْتَمَلْتُمَا (ištamaltumā) /iʃ.ta.mal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# اُشْتُمِلْتُمَا (uštumiltumā) /uʃ.tu.mil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
